objective: Plan September's rebalance: write trades/proposed/2026-09-30.json — the trades that move every position toward targets/2026-09-30.json at the 2026-09-30 prices, each sell naming the lots it comes from with the gain and the tax it realises — as a list a program computed and nobody has agreed to.
contribution: The arithmetic of the close, done by the workload's program under a wall-clock budget. Nothing it writes is a commitment: the confirm unit asks a person about this list and copies it under trades/pending/ after the yes.

fixed.subject: the target
fixed.decision: The target is targets/2026-09-30.json and is not changed by this unit.

fixed.subject: the universe and the exchangeable sets
fixed.decision: The universe and its exchangeable sets are universe.json; a trade names a ticker the target names, and the file is not extended.

fixed.subject: the band
fixed.decision: The band is 0.02 of the portfolio's value, the maximum deviation from the target any position lands at; it is the number benchmark.json carries, a person's file outside every write grant. No trade moves a position past its target.

fixed.subject: the tax parameters
fixed.decision: The rates, the long-term cutoff and the wash-sale window are tax.json; the jurisdiction is the one it declares, and the rules are its rules.

fixed.subject: which lots each sell comes from
fixed.decision: The tax ordering is a rule here, not a choice: a loss before a gain, and among gains a long-term lot before a short-term one; never a lot whose sale is a wash sale against another lot of the ticker acquired inside the window. Every sell names its lots with the gain or loss and the tax each realises.

fixed.subject: how far to trade
fixed.decision: All the way to the target in whole shares and never past it: an overweight is sold down to its target from the lots the ordering allows, and an underweight is bought toward its target with the cash there is.

fixed.subject: a position the target does not name
fixed.decision: Not traded. VNQ, which universe.json does not name, stays as it is; the review carries it as an open item, since a program surfaces nothing.

fixed.subject: nothing is agreed
fixed.decision: The list is written under trades/proposed/ and nowhere else. Nothing is written under trades/pending/: a file there is a commitment, and consent is a session's to ask (confirm-trades).

fixed.subject: trades/executed/
fixed.decision: The record of what was traded is the person's; a unit never writes there.

expectedEvidence.description: run_tests: the portfolio's own suite passes at the committed revision — the proposed list moves every position toward its target and not past it, lands inside the band, sells only from held lots, and creates no wash sale
run_checks: the static checks pass and the protected prefixes are untouched
